scope: One fixed registered training frame; nativeFP32 buffers/trainable masters and BF16 autocast. Compare losses and all populated parameter gradients with checkpointing disabled/enabled/restored. Hold weights/input/random draws fixed, no optimizer, clipping, updates, benchmark or rollout. No changes to production source/recipe or frozen RSI.
limitations: One backward example, not a training/generalization/robot-success test. Numerical differences are descriptive; equality is measured and not forced. An OOM is an operational limit, not architecture evidence.
